QUARANTINED [POS-003]: Legacy POS fabricates COGS via cost_price × qty when FIFO does not run | waiver approver=chief-verification-engineer expires=2026-10-11 | When stock is disabled or FIFO checkAvailability() returns false, COGS is fabricated as product.cost_price × qty instead of from consumed inventory batches. Corrupts gross profit on every affected sale. The report SQL at SaleController.php:521 has the same fallback. Production fix is the app team's ticket.

QUARANTINED [WOO-001]: WooCommerce webhook writes stock but posts NO journal entry | waiver approver=chief-verification-engineer expires=2026-10-11 | A WooCommerce order received via the webhook deducts stock but never creates a double-entry journal, so revenue/COGS/tax for online sales never reach the ledger. Every financial report understates online activity. Production fix is the app team's ticket.
